facts.fact: The vendor states that a daily Google Ads budget of $10 to $20 can capture meaningful local demand for a pawn shop.
facts.quote: even $10 to $20 a day can capture meaningful local demand

facts.fact: The vendor states that meaningful Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns start at a few dollars a day.
facts.quote: meaningful campaigns start at a few dollars a day

facts.fact: The vendor states that the three map listings at the top of Google Maps results capture most of the clicks for 'pawn shop near me' searches.
facts.quote: those three map listings at the top capture most of the clicks

facts.fact: The article is titled as a comparison of seven advertising channels for pawn shops.
AdWave's pawn shop advertising guide lists Google Ads cost for capturing urgent loan and sell searches at roughly $10-20 per day.
facts.quote: | Google Ads | Capturing urgent loan & sell searches | ~$10-20/day | Both | Medium |

facts.fact: AdWave's pawn shop advertising guide lists Facebook / Instagram ads as starting from roughly $5 per day.
facts.quote: | Facebook / Instagram | Showing inventory, building brand | From ~$5/day | Retail + brand | High |

facts.fact: AdWave's pawn shop guide states that Google Business Profile and local SEO are free to run, costing time rather than money.
facts.quote: Local SEO / Google Business | Being found in "near me" searches | Free (time) | Both | Medium |

facts.fact: AdWave's pawn shop guide states connected TV ads are now affordable and says a 30-second connected TV spot can be made from existing photos in minutes.
facts.quote: Connected TV lets you run a genuine 30-second video ad, showing your professional, welcoming store

facts.fact: AdWave's pawn shop guide says Google Ads at $10 to $20 a day, plus a small social ad budget, can drive meaningful traffic for a pawn shop.
facts.quote: From there, $10 to $20 a day on Google Ads and a small social ad budget can drive meaningful traffic.

facts.fact: AdWave's pawn shop guide describes a Google Ads and social media spending pattern where the cheapest channel for a small pawn shop is free local SEO and Google Business Profile.
facts.quote: many shops start effectively on a modest budget because their most important channels, local SEO, Google Business Profile, and organic social, are free to run.

facts.fact: AdWave's pawn shop guide lists seven advertising channels in its comparison table.
facts.quote: You don't need all seven channels at once.

facts.fact: Adwave's vendor page says customers can get started with Adwave from $30 a day.
facts.quote: check [pricing](https://adwave.com/pricing) to get started from $30 a day.

facts.fact: Adwave states it can generate a professional 30-second TV ad from a shop's photos and run it on connected TV.
facts.quote: generate a professional 30-second ad from your photos, then run it on connected TV and beyond, all from one place.
